pr_body:
The `remote_monitoring_agent` reserved role is extended to grant more privileges over the `metricbeat-*` index pattern.
In addition to the `index` and `create_index` index privileges that it granted already, it now also grants the `view_index_metadata` privilege.
See https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/63203 for more details.

The `remote_monitoring_collector` role has not been changed.

Reviewers might prefer to look at the https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/commit/ef1eb01178cd1d2754eec6b81a77362962eca975 commit for the diff, as the other commit https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/commit/c89d0e901a6023405eb42cb6ea130903bfc89b97 is a rename that clutters a bit the diff of the whole PR.

Closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/63203
pr_title: Add view_index_metadata over metricbeat-* for monitoring agent

review_comment: Why did you change it ti remoteMonitoringCollectorRole while the changes are added to remote_monitoring_agent?

It's mainly a rename see: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/commit/c89d0e901a6023405eb42cb6ea130903bfc89b97 .
Besides the rename, because the roles are similar sounding but different in scopee I've tested that only one of them grants the desired privileges.
